parsed.draft_response:
Hi—sorry about the disruption. I understand you’re seeing the same failure again and that nothing is working right now.

To get this investigated quickly, please reply with the minimum details below (even short answers are fine):
1) What changed since “last time” (date/time of the previous incident, or link/ticket number if you have it)?
2) Are you able to use the app at all, or is it failing for everyone or just your account?
3) Which specific feature(s)/workflow(s) don’t work (e.g., login, syncing, specific screens/actions)?
4) Any error message text you see (or screenshot) and the time it appeared.
5) Your environment/platform: production vs. staging, and your browser/device (if applicable).

Once we have that, we’ll escalate to the on-call/human review team to diagnose and work toward a resolution as quickly as possible. If you can share the error message + when it started, that will help us route immediately.
promised_actions: Escalate the report for human review to investigate the recurring failure and work toward resolution.
Request the minimum technical details needed to route and diagnose the issue.
safety_notes: Avoid promising a fix timing or refund.
Do not claim root cause or confirm an outage without receiving evidence.
